notes.title: RADIUS authentication works again on PHP 8.5 (PAP, CHAP-MD5, MS-CHAPv1 and MS-CHAPv2, with group and session attributes); broken since 1.1.0
System > Boot Environments refuses to activate a boot environment of an older release (1.0), as the REST API already did
WebUI hardening: the rule editor escapes the gateway in JavaScript, the LDAP container lookup needs a CSRF-checked POST, and unused jquery.cookie 1.3.1 (CVE-2022-23395) is removed
WebUI: PHP 8 fixes for undefined variables, array keys and null arguments on every page (a full E_ALL crawl is now clean of the known warnings)
Firewall aliases and rules: proxy ARP and other VIP subnets containing a 1 are listed again, and IPv6 VIP networks are skipped as intended (broken on PHP 8)
Diagnostics > GEOM Mirrors no longer stops with a fatal error when a form field is invalid
Installer: a serial console that reports no size gets the standard 24x80, so the ZFS install dialog works
Optional packages: PHP 8.5 deprecation fixes now reach updated systems (new revisions of WireGuard, Tailscale, ACME, OpenVPN export, Suricata, HAProxy and others)
System > Update > Settings explains the new Testing branch (nightly builds of the next Stable patch)
Supersedes 1.1.5; 1.1.6 to 1.1.8 were withdrawn before release and are included. Systems on 1.1.1 to 1.1.4 need the one-time console command from the 1.1.5 notes first
